name: Bodyweight Squat
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your hips while keeping your chest upright, then press through your feet to stand.

name: Push-Up
description: Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders. Lower your chest with a straight body, then push back to the starting position.

name: Forward Lunge
description: Step forward and lower both knees until the rear knee approaches the floor. Push through the front foot to return and alternate sides.

name: Forearm Plank
description: Support your body on your forearms and toes. Keep a straight line from shoulders to heels while breathing normally.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Lie on your back with knees bent. Lift your hips until your shoulders, hips, and knees form a straight line, then lower slowly.

name: Mountain Climber
description: Start in a high plank and alternately drive each knee toward your chest while keeping your hips controlled.

name: Jumping Jack
description: Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead, then jump back to the starting position at a steady pace.

name: Calf Raise
description: Stand upright, rise onto the balls of your feet, pause briefly, and lower your heels with control.

name: Bird Dog
description: From hands and knees, extend one arm and the opposite leg. Pause, return with control, and switch sides.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: Lie on your back and bring opposite elbow and knee together while extending the other leg. Alternate sides slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height. Press them overhead without arching your back, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Row
description: Support your body with one hand, pull a dumbbell toward your ribs, squeeze your back, and lower it slowly.

name: Biceps Curl
description: Stand with dumbbells at your sides. Bend your elbows to raise the weights, then lower them without swinging.

name: Triceps Extension
description: Hold one dumbbell overhead, bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, then extend your arms upward.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Hold a dumbbell close to your chest. Sit your hips down between your knees, then drive through your feet to stand.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hold weights in front of your thighs. Push your hips backward with a neutral spine, then squeeze your glutes to stand.

name: Step-Up
description: Place one foot on a stable step. Drive through that foot to stand on the step, lower carefully, and alternate sides.

name: High Knees
description: Run in place while lifting each knee toward hip height. Keep your torso upright and move your arms naturally.

name: Side Plank
description: Support your body on one forearm and the side of one foot. Keep your hips raised and your body in a straight line.

name: Superman Hold
description: Lie face down and gently lift your arms, chest, and legs from the floor. Hold briefly, then lower with control.
